full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white portrait presents a rugged middle-aged man beneath the shadow of a broad, worn brimmed hat. The frame is closely cropped around his head and upper shoulders, leaving only a pale, scuffed backdrop around the left and lower edges. His face turns a little toward the viewer's left while his narrowed eyes look outward from under the deep hat shadow. Strong brows, creases beside the eyes, a straight prominent nose, and tightly closed lips make the expression stern and concentrated. Dark stubble covers the jaw and cheek, with finer hairs and roughened skin visible in the midtones. The hat cuts a broad diagonal across the upper image; its crown is mottled and its band has a small irregular fastening near the center. A dark collar and shoulder occupy the lower right, breaking into scratchy grain and splashed marks at the border. The left side of the background remains light gray to off-white, marked by vertical smudges, scattered dots, and rubbed-looking patches. Rather than a pristine studio finish, the tonal surface combines photographic facial detail with charcoal-like abrasion and print texture. The brightest light arrives from the viewer's left and above, striking the ridge of the nose, cheekbone, and brim while the eyes stay partly shaded. Heavy blacks beneath the hat and along the clothing balance the pale empty field. The overall composition is blunt and graphic, with a diagonal dark shape pressing over a sharply modeled face in a weathered monochrome image.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形黑白肖像呈现一位粗犷的中年男子，头顶宽大且略显磨旧的帽檐投下阴影。画面紧贴头部和上肩裁切，左边及下边只留少量浅色、带擦痕的背景。他的脸稍向观者左侧转动，眯起的双眼从帽下深影中望出。浓眉、眼旁皱纹、挺直突出的鼻子和紧闭双唇使表情显得严厉而专注。下颌与面颊布满深色胡茬，中间调中还能看见更细的毛发和粗糙肤理。帽子在画面上方划出宽阔的斜线；帽冠色泽斑驳，帽带中央附近有一个不规则的小扣饰。深色衣领与肩部占据右下角，并在边缘融入刮擦般颗粒与飞溅痕。左侧背景保持浅灰至灰白色，带竖向污痕、散点和擦磨过的斑块。画面的色调表面结合摄影式面部细节与炭笔般的磨损、印刷肌理，而非完美洁净的影棚效果。最亮的光从观者左上方到来，落在鼻梁、颧骨和帽檐上，眼睛仍部分处于阴影。帽下和衣服上的浓黑与浅色留白区取得平衡。整体构图直接而有图形力量，一道斜向暗形压在鲜明塑造的面孔上，形成饱经风霜的单色图像。
style_prompt_en: The image has a gritty monochrome photographic treatment, with detailed midtone modeling set against abraded, print-like marks. Deep blacks gather along a broad diagonal, while pale gray open areas expose smudges, scratches, and irregular grain. Sharp contours around the focal form give way to rubbed and splattered edges near the frame, so realism and graphic distress coexist. Short rough textures interrupt otherwise smooth tonal gradients. High light from one side lifts ridges and leaves recessed regions in thick shade, producing forceful contrast without eliminating every middle tone. Close cropping and an uneven dark-light balance make the composition terse, physical, and severe.
style_prompt_zh: 画面采用粗粝的单色摄影处理，在细致中间调塑造之外叠加磨损的印刷般痕迹。浓黑沿宽阔斜线聚集，浅灰开阔区域则显露污痕、刮痕与不规则颗粒。焦点形体周围轮廓锐利，靠画框处逐渐变为擦磨和飞溅的边缘，使写实与图形化磨损并存。短促粗糙的肌理打断原本平滑的明暗渐变。来自一侧的高位光抬亮凸起处，使凹处留在厚重阴影中，产生有力反差而没有抹去全部中间调。紧凑裁切及不均衡的明暗面积使构图简练、实在且严厉。
theme_en: A grainy black-and-white close portrait of a weathered man under a broad hat
theme_zh: 宽檐帽下饱经风霜的男子黑白颗粒近景肖像
name: Clint Eastwood
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
